channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: IMF cuts 2026 world growth forecast, citing Iran war fallout
item.description: Global economy to grow 3 percent in 2026, as AI demand partly offsets energy shock from Iran war, IMF says.

item.title: Confirmed Ebola deaths in DR Congo hit 600
item.description: The number of deaths comes as healthcare workers threaten to walk off the job over a delay in payments.

item.title: Eight killed as landslide hits Rohingya school in Bangladesh
item.description: At least seven children and a teacher were killed after a landslide hit a girls’ school at a refugee camp in Bangladesh.

item.title: Tehran releases footage showing ruins of late Iranian leader’s compound
item.description: Iranian state media has released what it calls the first footage showing damage to the late Khamenei’s compound.

item.title: Khamenei’s coffin in Karbala on last stop before burial in Mashhad
item.description: Millions gathered in the holy city of Karbala, Iraq to pay their respects at the funeral of Iran’s late supreme leader.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran hits Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar after deadly US strikes
item.description: Iranian official says US strikes over the past two days have killed at least 14 people and wounded 78.

item.title: US launches more strikes on Iran with blasts reported in south of country
item.description: Trump says the attacks are "retribution for yesterday's bombing of ships by Iran". Iran earlier promised strong retaliation.

item.title: Eight killed after landslide hits girls' school in Bangladesh
item.description: Rescuers pull bodies from the mud after heavy monsoon rains batter the south-eastern coast.

item.title: Khamenei's coffin carried through Shia shrines as ceremonies held in Iraq
item.description: The remains of Iran's late supreme leader are transported to Najaf and Karbala, as funeral ceremonies continue for a fifth day.

item.title: Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail
item.description: The lawyer for Dr Hussam Abu Safiya tells the BBC his client was so badly beaten he could not recognise him during a visit last week.
